CREATE TABLE storage_contract(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(name='next-v1'), validity_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
INSERT INTO storage_contract(id,name) VALUES(1,'next-v1')

CREATE TABLE sources(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('PDF','AUTHOR')), title TEXT NOT NULL, current_revision_id TEXT REFERENCES source_revisions(id), deleted_at TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE source_revisions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, source_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sources(id), ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, blob_ref TEXT NOT NULL, byte_size INTEGER NOT NULL, original_name TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(source_id,ordinal))
CREATE INDEX ix_source_hash ON source_revisions(sha256)

CREATE TABLE parse_runs(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, source_revision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_revisions(id), parser_version TEXT NOT NULL, config_json TEXT NOT NULL, input_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, artifact_ref TEXT NOT NULL, artifact_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE evidence_anchors(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, source_revision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_revisions(id), parse_run_id TEXT REFERENCES parse_runs(id), page_number INTEGER CHECK(page_number IS NULL OR page_number>0), locator_json TEXT NOT NULL, quoted_text TEXT NOT NULL, sha256 TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX ix_evidence_source ON evidence_anchors(source_revision_id)

CREATE TABLE notes(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('ATOMIC','CONCEPT','MOC')), title TEXT NOT NULL, domain TEXT NOT NULL, aliases_json TEXT NOT NULL, current_revision_id TEXT REFERENCES note_revisions(id), stable_path TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, visibility TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' CHECK(visibility IN ('ACTIVE','WITHDRAWN','MERGED')), redirect_id TEXT REFERENCES notes(id), created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE note_revisions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, note_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES notes(id), parent_revision_id TEXT REFERENCES note_revisions(id), ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, summary TEXT NOT NULL, scope_json TEXT NOT NULL, markdown_ref TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, markdown_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, input_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, policy_version TEXT NOT NULL, author TEXT NOT NULL, checks_json TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('PUBLISHED','WITHDRAWN')), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(note_id,ordinal))

CREATE TABLE sections(revision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES note_revisions(id), section_id TEXT NOT NULL, position INTEGER NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, question TEXT NOT NULL, scope_json TEXT NOT NULL, start_offset INTEGER NOT NULL, end_offset INTEGER NOT NULL, sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, protected INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY(revision_id,section_id), UNIQUE(revision_id,position), CHECK(start_offset>=0 AND end_offset>=start_offset))

CREATE TABLE section_evidence(revision_id TEXT NOT NULL, section_id TEXT NOT NULL, evidence_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES evidence_anchors(id), role TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(revision_id,section_id,evidence_id,role), FOREIGN KEY(revision_id,section_id) REFERENCES sections(revision_id,section_id))

CREATE TABLE concept_inputs(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, concept_revision_id TEXT NOT NULL, section_id TEXT NOT NULL, atomic_revision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES note_revisions(id), selection_json TEXT NOT NULL, evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL, role TEXT NOT NULL, action TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(concept_revision_id,section_id) REFERENCES sections(revision_id,section_id))
CREATE INDEX ix_concept_dependency ON concept_inputs(atomic_revision_id)

CREATE TABLE links(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, from_revision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES note_revisions(id), from_section_id TEXT, target_note_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES notes(id), target_section_id TEXT, relation TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, basis_json TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE map_entries(map_revision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES note_revisions(id), entry_id TEXT NOT NULL, parent_entry_id TEXT, position INTEGER NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, target_note_id TEXT REFERENCES notes(id), target_revision_id TEXT REFERENCES note_revisions(id), description TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(map_revision_id,entry_id), FOREIGN KEY(map_revision_id,parent_entry_id) REFERENCES map_entries(map_revision_id,entry_id))

CREATE TABLE events(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, dedupe_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, event_type TEXT NOT NULL, entity_id TEXT NOT NULL, revision_id TEXT, payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'QUEUED', created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE jobs(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, event_id TEXT REFERENCES events(id), kind TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, input_json TEXT NOT NULL, lease_owner TEXT, lease_until TEXT, attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, result_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', error_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE build_artifacts(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, job_id TEXT REFERENCES jobs(id), kind TEXT NOT NULL, storage_ref TEXT NOT NULL, sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, policy_version TEXT NOT NULL, input_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE embedding_profiles(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, provider TEXT NOT NULL, model TEXT NOT NULL, dimensions INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(dimensions>0), normalization TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(normalization IN ('L2','NONE')), text_policy TEXT NOT NULL, config_json TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE chunks(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, revision_id TEXT NOT NULL, section_id TEXT NOT NULL, start_offset INTEGER NOT NULL, end_offset INTEGER NOT NULL, sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(revision_id,section_id) REFERENCES sections(revision_id,section_id), CHECK(start_offset>=0 AND end_offset>start_offset))

CREATE TABLE index_entries(chunk_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chunks(id), profile_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES embedding_profiles(id), generation TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, vector_ref TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(chunk_id,profile_id,generation))

CREATE TRIGGER knowledge_chunks_insert BEFORE INSERT ON chunks
        WHEN (SELECT n.kind FROM note_revisions r JOIN notes n ON n.id=r.note_id WHERE r.id=NEW.revision_id) NOT IN ('ATOMIC','CONCEPT')
        OR NEW.start_offset < (SELECT start_offset FROM sections WHERE revision_id=NEW.revision_id AND section_id=NEW.section_id)
        OR NEW.end_offset > (SELECT end_offset FROM sections WHERE revision_id=NEW.revision_id AND section_id=NEW.section_id)
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Only ATOMIC/CONCEPT section ranges can be indexed'); END

CREATE TRIGGER knowledge_chunks_update BEFORE UPDATE OF revision_id,section_id,start_offset,end_offset ON chunks
        WHEN (SELECT n.kind FROM note_revisions r JOIN notes n ON n.id=r.note_id WHERE r.id=NEW.revision_id) NOT IN ('ATOMIC','CONCEPT')
        OR NEW.start_offset < (SELECT start_offset FROM sections WHERE revision_id=NEW.revision_id AND section_id=NEW.section_id)
        OR NEW.end_offset > (SELECT end_offset FROM sections WHERE revision_id=NEW.revision_id AND section_id=NEW.section_id)
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Only ATOMIC/CONCEPT section ranges can be indexed'); END
